description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: Finish checkout and see a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A customer account is available and logged in (if login is required). The cart contains <at least one orderable item>. Any data the checkout asks for is available: <checkout details required by the application, e.g. address and payment data>.
steps: Open the cart containing <at least one orderable item>.
Fill in the data the checkout requests using <valid checkout details>.
Confirm/submit the order to finish checkout.
cases.expected: Checkout completes and a confirmation is shown to the user. The exact content, wording and layout of the confirmation are not specified in the story.
